summary: Aroostook County, ME 75-foot steel fire tower built in 1924 by the Maine Forest Department; listed standing by FFLA; no current access or condition source found.

facts.design: Steel fire watch tower, 75 feet tall
facts.agency: Maine Forest Department (built it, per Maine Memory); Maine Forestry District (per Forest Lookouts)

events.note: Maine Memory record and the April and July 1924 Daily Kennebec Journal items quoted by Forest Lookouts; one Maine Memory slideshow dates it 1925

evidence.supports: location: T8 R5 WELS, Aroostook County
evidence.quote: T8 R5 WELS, Aroostook County, ME

evidence.supports: the Maine Forest Department built the steel tower in 1924
evidence.quote: The Maine Forest Department built the steel Oak Hill Mountain fire watch tower in 1924

evidence.supports: the tower sits at an elevation of 1,096 feet
evidence.quote: was built at an elevation of 1,096 feet

evidence.supports: April 1924: state bought steel for a 75-foot tower on Oak Hill
evidence.quote: Steel was bought for building the following lookout stations

evidence.supports: July 1924: a construction crew had put up the 75-foot tower
evidence.quote: The construction crew have already put up this year a 75-foot tower on Oak Hill
This 75-foot steel tower was built in 1925 at Oak Hill Mountain in Aroostook County.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists the tower as standing
the Forest Lookouts page quotes only the two 1924 items; it names no cab or staff
evidence.quote: Quite a little bit of work has been done by the State forestry department in preparing for the 1924 season

sources.title: Oak Hill Mountain fire lookout tower, ca. 1924
Looking Out: Maine's Fire Towers, slideshow slide 26

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1924 per the Maine Memory record and two 1924 Daily Kennebec Journal items quoted by Forest Lookouts; the Maine Memory slideshow says 1925 and is not followed

notes_for_editor: Access, ownership and current condition not found in the sources read, so no access fact is recorded. Staffing not found. FFLA lists it as standing with no asterisk. Facebook group posts from 2026 about the tower were seen only as search snippets and a short fetched header, so they are not used. Height: 75 feet from both Maine Memory and Forest Lookouts; height_m is that figure converted. The record's agency line matches the Forest Lookouts header. Used 2 WebSearch and about 5 page reads.
